source_documents.title: Aggregation-induced emission and polymorphism/shape/size-dependent emission behaviours of fenamates for potential drug evaluation

reference_evidence_units.quote: the emission was switched on starting from 50% volume fraction of water
reference_evidence_units.subject: TFA
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Ethanol/water anti-solvent crystallization; two supersaturation protocols, Fig. 2.
reference_evidence_units.statement: TFA fluorescence appears from 50% water and increases with crystal formation.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: This onset belongs to TFA, not automatically FFA or MFA.

reference_evidence_units.quote: Metastable TFA II was obtained under high supersaturation while the stable TFA I emerged under low supersaturation
reference_evidence_units.subject: TFA polymorph selection
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Different initial solution supersaturations; Fig. 2 and p.6 preparations.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Supersaturation controls crystal form and emission color.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Source-reported stability; no new thermodynamic assessment.

reference_evidence_units.quote: TFA I and TFA II emit blueviolet light (λem = 421 nm) and turquoise light (λem = 473 nm), respectively
reference_evidence_units.subject: TFA polymorphs
reference_evidence_units.conditions: 365 nm excitation; Table 1 and SI Fig. S13 referenced.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Polymorph II is red-shifted 52 nm relative to I.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: 473 nm corresponds to specified large crystals, not every TFA II morphology.

reference_evidence_units.subject: TFA polymorphs
reference_evidence_units.statement: TFA I/II reported QY values are 67.7/19.3 and lifetimes 4.25/6.74; II column specifies large crystals 2-3 mm.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Printed table omits explicit QY/lifetime units; retain values as printed. Other fenamate values not transferred.

reference_evidence_units.quote: a better coplanarity of TFA II is prone to make the lone pair of electrons on nitrogen form conjugation with two adjacent benzene rings.
reference_evidence_units.subject: TFA polymorphs
reference_evidence_units.statement: Authors explain narrower gap and redder lower-QY II emission through better conjugation.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: No direct CT-state assignment; no independent rate calculation is inferred.

reference_evidence_units.quote: which obviously limits the rotation and vibration of molecules
reference_evidence_units.subject: fenamate dimers including TFA
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Hydrogen-bonded dimers in Fig. 3; TFA I/II interactions broadly similar.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Authors invoke hydrogen bonding limiting rotation/vibration as an enabling series mechanism.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: MFA dominates this passage; retain series scope and do not claim directly measured TFA RIM.

reference_evidence_units.quote: Emission differences were also founded in the large- size crystals and small-size crystals of TFA II
reference_evidence_units.subject: TFA II size control
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Fig. 4f-j, visually inspected; same polymorph checked by reported SI PXRD.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Small and large TFA II crystals differ; plot labels show maxima 462 and 473 nm.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: SI facet-resolved and PXRD controls not inspected; do not transfer MFA shape effects.

reference_evidence_units.quote: different crystal faces may have different photoluminescence behaviours
reference_evidence_units.subject: TFA and MFA crystal-face interpretation
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Micro-Raman spatially resolved PL and morphology comparison.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Authors attribute size/shape spectral differences to different contributions of crystal faces.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Bounded morphology interpretation, not proof of new intermolecular excited state.

reference_mechanisms.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Explicit dimer rotation/vibration restriction retained only at series-level scope.

reference_mechanisms.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Crystal conformation, polymorph and face contributions are the main source explanations.

mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target host-guest binding mechanism is established; ordinary solvent polarity is not host inclusion.

mechanism_decisions.label: ICT_TICT_CT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific charge-transfer excited-state assignment is established in the selected evidence.

mechanism_decisions.label: ESIPT_PT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No excited-state proton-transfer photophysics is established. Ground-state protonation or hydrogen bonding alone is insufficient.

mechanism_decisions.label: PET_ET
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific photoinduced electron-transfer pathway is established in the selected evidence.

mechanism_decisions.label: AGGREGATE_EXCITON_EXCIMER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific aggregate exciton, excimer or exciplex assignment is established; aggregation or close packing alone is insufficient.

mechanism_decisions.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No distinct radiative-rate or bright/dark-state balance mechanism is established beyond the other pathways; intensity and lifetime alone are insufficient.

mechanism_decisions.label: TRIPLET_METAL_ENERGY_TRANSFER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific triplet, metal-centered or energy-transfer pathway is established; metal binding alone is insufficient.

mechanism_decisions.label: RACI_CI_ACCESS
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific conical-intersection access mechanism is established.

mechanism_decisions.label: SOKR_ANTI_KASHA
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No higher-state emission or suppression of Kasha's rule is established.
